# Effrix

> Effrix publishes gPlayer, an open-source Telegram media player for Fire TV and Android TV; HaloNotch, a free open-source notch hub for MacBook and Windows; and Effrix Books, Bible coloring books for kids by Ephraim Mathew on Amazon KDP.

## Products

- [gPlayer](https://effrix.com/gplayer.html): Stream the videos, photos and documents in your own Telegram account to Amazon Fire TV and Android TV using only the remote. Free, no ads, built on Telegram's official TDLib, MIT licensed. Also known as GrammPlayer and tgPlayer. Fire OS, Android TV, Android 5.0+.
- [HaloNotch](https://effrix.com/halonotch.html): Turns the MacBook notch into a hub — dashboard, weather (Open-Meteo), screen time, clipboard history with PIN vault, file tray, media, calendar (join Teams/Zoom/Meet), reminders, focus tools and opt-in Claude Code / Codex usage. Free and open source. macOS 14+, Windows 10/11 (preview).
- [Effrix Books](https://effrix.com/books.html): Thick-outline coloring books for kids 3–10 by Ephraim Mathew. Matte cover, white paper, black and white interior. Sold on 14 Amazon marketplaces (US, UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, SE, BE, IE, JP, CA, AU); the page has a marketplace selector.

## gPlayer

- [gPlayer on Amazon Appstore](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H85JCRT1): Primary install for Fire TV.
- [gPlayer APK v3.4](https://effrix.com/releases/tgPlayer_v3.4_304_release.apk): Direct download for Android TV sideloading.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/abinsabu2/GrammPlayer): MIT License.

## HaloNotch

- [HaloNotch on GitHub](https://github.com/abinsabu2/HaloNotch): Source and releases (macOS zip, Windows preview x64/arm64 zip). Builds are unsigned.

## Books

- [My First Bible Stories Coloring Book — Read, Color, and Remember God Loves You!](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HKMWWLCH): ASIN B0HKMWWLCH, ISBN 9798175744331. 15 Bible stories (Creation to John 3:16), coloring scene on the left, Grade-1 story on the right. Ages 3–8, 8.5" × 8.5", 32 pages. Published 2026-09-20.
- [Jesus and Friends: Big & Easy Bible Story Coloring Book for Toddlers](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HJRHS916): ASIN B0HJRHS916, ISBN 9798173634481. Large bold Bible scenes for toddlers and preschoolers, single-sided pages. Ages 3–8, 8.5" × 11", 34 pages. Published 2026-09-12.
- [The Legendary Web Hero and Friends](https://effrix.com/books.html#webhero): 15 inspirational hero stories to colour about courage, kindness and teamwork. Ages 4–10, 8.5" × 11", 34 pages. Coming soon.
